name: Stroll into Darkness
source:
Follow the power lines. Observe the birds. There’s more to them than meets the eye – and only careful attention will reveal the truth.

[From [url=https://dreadshadow.itch.io/stroll-into-darkness]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
循著電線走。觀察那些鳥。它們不像表面看起來那麼簡單，唯有仔細留心，真相才會顯現。

［取自[url=https://dreadshadow.itch.io/stroll-into-darkness]itch.io[/url]］
